name: Gargantuan Tumor
summary: In Teldrassil, a great growth was torn from Oakenscowl, the corrupted timberling by Lake Al'Ameth. The tumor bears witness to sickness spreading among the creatures there.

sections.title: Blight Upon the Lake
sections.body: Oakenscowl lurks in a cavern near Lake Al'Ameth's southern bank. Once a noble timberling elder, the creature has fallen to a vile affliction. A huge growth poisoned Oakenscowl, warped its behavior, and spread taint through the surrounding wildlife. The tumor was severed to end the beast's rampage and give local researchers a chance to examine the blight. They hope to learn how the malady took root in the boughs of the newly grown World Tree.

faq.q: Where does the Gargantuan Tumor come from?
faq.answer: The Gargantuan Tumor comes from Oakenscowl, a large corrupted timberling in a cave on Lake Al'Ameth's southern shore in Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is causing the tumor to grow on Oakenscowl?
aliases: why does oakenscowl have a tumor
faq.answer: The tumor is a visible sign of the strange corruption poisoning timberlings and wildlife around Lake Al'Ameth. Oakenscowl was once a grand leader of its kind, but the growth overcame it.

faq.q: Who wants to study this tumor?
faq.answer: Investigators in the area want the tumor to study the strange rot afflicting local timberlings and learn how to treat or halt the blight.

angles.text: As a druid tending Teldrassil's young boughs, you can see in the tumor how vulnerable nature there is to corruption.
As a night elf, you see a respected elder timberling reduced to a mad, blighted monster, a sign of the troubles facing your new homeland.
